sentences.text: 4. State counsel on instructions from SI Sulinder Singh submits that indeed, the petitioners have joined investigation with the police and should join further investigation as and when called to do so by the police officials.

5. Counsel appearing on behalf of the complainant has admitted the fact that now the matter has been compromised between the parties and compromise quashing petition is already filed by the petitioners.
6. Counsel for the complainant further expressed no objection if the present petition is allowed and order of interim bail dated 12.9.2024 is made absolute.

7. In view of the above, without commenting on the merits of the case, the present petition is allowed and order of interim bail dated 12.9.2024 is hereby made absolute subject to the conditions as envisaged under Section 482(2) BNSS.
It is further made clear that the petitioners should join further investigation as and when called to do so by the police.
